get.description: Perform a simple healthcheck on the database and backend of Zipline. Returns a simple pass/fail response.

pass.description: true if the server and db are reachable and functioning.

get.description: Return whether Zipline is in first-time setup mode, used by the initial setup flow.

post.description: Perform the first-time setup by creating the initial SUPERADMIN user.

get.description: Get instance-wide metrics and statistics for Zipline over a given date range or for all time.
Return backend version information, including current build details and upstream/latest version metadata.

post.description: Authenticate a user, creating a session and optionally requiring a TOTP code when multi-factor auth is enabled.

get.description: Log out the currently authenticated user and invalidate their active session.

post.description: Register a new user account and immediately authenticate them, optionally consuming an invite code.

get.description: Generate WebAuthn authentication options for logging in with an existing passkey.

post.description: Verify a WebAuthn authentication response and log in the user associated with the matching passkey.

delete.description: Delete temporary files on the Zipline server and return a short status message (admin only).

get.description: Scan for zero-byte files on disk and return the list of candidates to delete (admin only).

delete.description: Delete zero-byte files previously detected on disk and return a short status message (admin only).

get.description: Export Zipline server data as a version 4 export bundle or return aggregate counts of core resources.
Fetch a public view of a folder by ID, including files, child folders, and parent chain when allowed.
Return the public Zipline configuration used by the client, including OAuth, website, feature, file and chunk settings.

post.description: Re-scan stored files to update their sizes and optionally delete missing ones, returning a short status message (admin only).

get.description: List all available themes and indicate which theme is currently configured as the default.

post.description: Manually trigger the thumbnails background task, optionally rerunning it for existing files (admin only).
Upload one or more files for the authenticated user, applying quota, folder, and upload option restrictions.
Upload a single file in chunks as a partial upload session, using headers to control chunking and resumption.

get.description: Return the current user's avatar as a base64 data URL.
List your exports or download a specific completed export archive by ID.

delete.description: Delete a specific export and remove its archive file from storage.

post.description: Start an export job that zips all of your files into a downloadable archive.

get.description: Get the currently authenticated user and their token.

patch.description: Update the current user's profile, credentials, avatar, and view settings.

get.description: Get the most recently uploaded files for the authenticated user.
List the current browser session and other active sessions for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Invalidate one or all other sessions for the authenticated user.

get.description: View aggregate statistics for the authenticated user's files and URLs.
Return an encrypted API token for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Refresh the user's underlying token secret and return an updated token and user object.

get.description: List users in the instance, optionally excluding the current admin from the results (admin only).

post.description: Create a new user with the given username, password, avatar, and role (admin only).

get.description: Fetch a specific invite by ID or code, including information about the inviter (admin only).

delete.description: Delete a specific invite by ID (admin only).

post.description: Create a new invite code for user registration, optionally limiting uses and expiration (admin only).

get.description: List all existing invite codes and their metadata (admin only).
Look up a public invite by code for the web UI, returning basic information about the inviter and usage limits.
List OAuth providers currently linked to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Unlink one OAuth provider from the authenticated user, enforcing that at least one login method remains.

post.description: Import data from a legacy Zipline v3 export file, creating users, files, folders and URLs and returning a mapping of old IDs to new IDs.
Import data from a Zipline v4 export file, optionally merging into the current user and returning counts of imported records.

get.description: Fetch the full Zipline server settings row along with a list of configuration keys that were overridden at runtime (admin only).

patch.description: Partially update Zipline server settings using a validated subset of configuration keys (admin only).

get.description: Return the safe dashboard configuration and MIME type code map used by the web UI.
List incomplete or still-processing file uploads for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete one or more incomplete file records owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: List, filter, and search files for the authenticated user (or another user if permitted).

patch.description: Bulk update files owned by the user: favorite/unfavorite or move them into a folder.

delete.description: Bulk delete files (and optionally delete the underlying datasource objects).

get.description: List folders for the authenticated user, optionally including files or filtering by parent/root.

post.description: Create a new folder for the authenticated user, optionally public and/or seeded with files.

get.description: Fetch a specific tag by ID, ensuring it is owned by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a specific tag owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Update the name and/or color of a specific tag.

get.description: List all tags created by the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new tag with a name and color for organizing files.
Register a new WebAuthn passkey for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Remove an existing passkey credential from your account.

get.description: Generate WebAuthn registration options for creating a new passkey.
Get your current TOTP secret, generating one (and a QR code) if not yet enabled.

post.description: Enable TOTP for your account by verifying a code for the provided secret.

delete.description: Disable TOTP for your account after confirming a valid TOTP code.

post.description: Create a new shortened URL for the authenticated user, with optional vanity, password, and max-views settings.

get.description: List or search shortened URLs owned by the authenticated user.
Fetch a specific user by ID, including their profile and role (admin only).

patch.description: Update another user's profile, credentials, role, and optional file quota limits (admin only).

delete.description: Delete another user by ID, optionally cascading deletion of their files and URLs (admin only).

get.description: List tags owned by the specified user, enforcing role-based interaction rules (admin only).
Fetch a single file owned by the authenticated user (or another user if permitted) by ID or short name.

patch.description: Update metadata for a single file, including favorite, name, tags, password, and view limits.

post.description: Verify the password for a password-protected file by ID or name.

get.description: Stream a file or thumbnail owned by the authenticated user by ID, with optional password and download handling.
Download a ZIP archive of all files contained in a folder and its subfolders.
Fetch a specific folder by ID, including files, children, and its parent chain.

put.description: Add a file to a specific folder owned by the user.

patch.description: Update a folder's visibility, name, upload permissions, or parent.

post.description: Verify the password for a password-protected short URL by ID, code, or vanity.
